newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Quake jolts Philippine city, stirs mild panic.
newsitem.headline: Quake jolts Philippine city, stirs mild panic.

text.p: An earthquake jolted the mountain city of Baguio in the northern Philippines on Wednesday, sending panicky residents running into the streets but there were no casualties or damage, police said.
The 3:23 p.m. (0723 gmt) tremor registered a magnitude of 4.5 on the Richter scale and was centred 11 km (seven miles) southwest of the city, seismologists said.
Baguio was among areas devastated by a 7.8 magnitude quake in July 1990 that killed more than 1,500 in the mountainous region.
Baguio deputy police chief James Dogao said dozens of people ran out of buildings when Wednesday's quake struck.
"People may have already developed a phobia for these things because of what happened in 1990," he said.
